SVC_TUYA.name: Tuya BLE (0xFD50)
SVC_TUYA.description: Bluetooth SIG assigned Tuya service. Current ThingClips stack uses this for command write + notify. Indexes GATT identity.

CHR_TUYA_WRITE.name: Tuya Write
CHR_TUYA_WRITE.description: App → device. Fragmented Tuya PDU (version nibble 2): varint index, first fragment also varint length + (version<<4), then flag + [IV] + AES-CBC body. Unencrypted device-info uses flag 0x00.

structure.description: LEB128 frame index; 0 starts a PDU
First fragment only; LEB128 length of the assembled outer PDU
First fragment only; high nibble is protocol version (2 → 0x20)
flag (1) + optional IV (16) + sn(4) ack(4) cmd(2) len(2) data CRC16-MODBUS(2)

CHR_TUYA_NOTIFY.name: Tuya Notify
CHR_TUYA_NOTIFY.description: Device → app. Same fragmentation as CHR_TUYA_WRITE. Subscribe (CCCD 0x0100) before writing.

SVC_TUYA_LEGACY.name: Tuya BLE legacy (0x1910)
SVC_TUYA_LEGACY.description: Older Tuya modules; write 0x2B11, notify 0x2B10. GATT identity treats this as layout 1910 when 0xFD50 is absent.
